author: Bobby Grayson
description: Harness limitation, not a repo problem. check.sh on main stayed green throughout. Resumed the same run with resumeFromRunId; the two non-isolated agents' prompts changed because their input (the empty build list) changed, so they re-run rather than replay.
title: First workflow run: all five builders failed at startup because the harness's worktree isolation still saw the session as 'not a git repository' (git init happened after session start). Integrator and verifier correctly reported nothing to merge. Fix: builders create their own worktrees with plain git under ../lean_analysis-wf/
